data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 42–43):** **`هَٰذَا`** ka matlab **'Yeh'** (muzakkar) hai. Agar `هَٰذَا` ke baad **Tanween (`ـٌ`)** wala lafz aaye toh **mukammal jumla** banta hai (`هَٰذَا كِتَابٌ` = Yeh ek kitaab hai). Aur agar `هَٰذَا` ke baad **`الْـ`** wala lafz aaye toh sirf **adhoora qat'ah** banta hai (`هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنُ` = Yeh Qur'an).

data.text: Agar (هٰذَا) ke baad aane wala lafz (الْـ) se shuru ho, toh yeh mukammal jumla nahi banta kyunke (هٰذَا) aur agla lafz milkar ek hi cheez banate hain jaise (هٰذَا الْكِتَابُ). Aisi soorat mein yeh do alfaaz aam taur par kisi doosre jumle ka hissa hote hain. iss baat ko behtar samajhne ke liye 'Yeh' aur 'Kitaab' do lafz milkar jumla nahi balke ek murakkab (phrase) banate hain jo jumle mein faa'il ya maf'ool ban sakta hai.
